messages:
kevin: kicking off staged attenuation for router service now, target v3.14.0 -> green pool. planning small nudges to reduce p95 delta. change window: 10m quiet window, then observe 30m.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: router v3.14.0 -> green; initial percent=5; step=5; max=50; step_interval=5m; operator=kevin
maria: noted. I'll watch latency panels and error rates. linking release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/3.14.0 (breaking: config change for header-normalizer)
kevin: pinning session-affinity to legacy for 12h during ramp (route pin: session-affinity=legacy). if we see 5xx spike >0.8% within step, we pause and revert.
sre-oncall: @kevin set my pager to high sensitivity for the next 2h. what's our rollback command if we need immediate revert?
kevin: immediate revert: `deploy-bot rollback --service=router --to=blue --force` (this will drain green and shift back). prefer graceful revert: `rb shift --service=router --to=blue --percent=100 --duration=2m`
lucy: adding a telemetry gate: require model inference p95 < 280ms and error rate <0.6% across all edge pods. if gate fails, automation will pin at previous traffic.
product-ops: just flagging the customer-facing note: sent update to beta customers about brief perf variance window.
kevin: starting first nudge -> 5% to green
deploy-bot: action: traffic_shift started; from=blue; to=green; percent=5; step=1; cmd=rb shift
maria: :eyes: metrics look quiet so far, p50 steady, p95 +10ms which is expected with cache-warm. no errors.
sre-oncall: seeing a tiny uptick in spikes on one zk-edge node (0.12%), not concerning yet. watching.
kevin: will hold 5m to let prefix cache warm. next planned increase to 10% at T+5m if stable.
lucy: side check: LB weights applied with attenuation=0.6, so effective traffic commit will be conservative. good.
kevin: bumping to 10%
deploy-bot: action: traffic_shift progress; new_percent=10
maria: p95 is +22ms on eu-west, but error rate still 0.4%. looks reasonable. recording as baseline for this shift.
sre-oncall: small error cluster from pod router-7 (OOM at 02:13 UTC), restarted and healthy. not systemic.
kevin: note: pin router config to v3.13.8 on legacy route for rollback target, keeping v3.14 in green pool. this gives quick fallback.
maria: updated runbook note: `if p95>350ms OR errors>0.8% for two consecutive steps -> rollback`. saving snapshots of dashboards.
product-ops: thumbs for comms plan: will draft standby update if we hit rollback.
kevin: planning next step to 25% after 10m if no gating failures. anyone object?
lucy: no objections. add memory headroom check on green pods before 25%.
sre-oncall: memory headroom looks fine at current load. will alert if <15%.
kevin: proceeding to 25% in 10m; will post final go/no-go at T+9m
maria: copying logs export command if needed:
```
kubectl logs -l app=router -n prod --since=15m | grep -i error | head -n 200
```
deploy-bot: scheduled: next_step at 3951235167 -> percent=25
kevin: thanks all. keep pings in this thread. I'll hit rollback command if gate trips or SRE asks.
sre-oncall: understood. on call will initiate revert if we cross thresholds. :white_check_mark:
maria: baseline capture complete. saved dashboard snapshot id=snap-2026-03-20-10-15
kevin: end of preflight checks. moving into steady watch window. will update when we start 25% nudge.
